The '''Nyenthi'Oris Graveyard''' was a sacred [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] burial place in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]]. The graveyard lay
on a small isle in the [[Chenataa river]], next to the [[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Great Tree]]. It was watched by the [[Spirit Guide]].

==Behind the scenes==
This place was implemented by the developers of [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', as a place in the Kkowir Forest region where killed players could respawn (clone).
